audio_transcribe.description: Transcribe an allowed audio asset; unknown confidence remains null.

conversation_read.description: Read bounded actual dialogue in the current scope.

group_action_propose.description: Propose a configured group operation; never self-authorize.

group_query.description: Query current-group members, file descriptions or proposal state.

interaction_propose.description: Propose a native interaction; host policy decides execution.

knowledge_evidence.description: Read allowed evidence snippets, not unrelated conversation history.

knowledge_search.description: Find scoped knowledge reports with evidence and uncertainty.

media_catalog.description: List safe media references and available delivery capabilities.

skill_load.description: Load owner-enabled skill instructions; not install or execute code.

vision_analyze.description: Analyze an allowed image asset, never an arbitrary URL.
